Container.Name: ruijie-router-monitor
Container.Overview: Local Ruijie/Reyee eWeb network monitor. Uses direct HTTP API collection, stores telemetry in appdata, and provides a browser dashboard for clients, AP locations, traffic, RSSI, and activity paths.
Container.Requires: The appdata directory must be writable by Unraid's nobody:users account. Configure router credentials from the first-run Web UI instead of putting secrets in this template.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the monitor web UI.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent configuration, administrator sessions, SQLite database, telemetry, and retained client history.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone used for operational logs.

Config.Name: Allow in-app restart
Config.Description: Allows the dashboard restart button to exit the process. Docker restart policy starts it again.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Keep false for direct HTTP Web UI. Set true only behind HTTPS reverse proxy.
